r.name: Percorso ciclabile Balmuccia-Alagna
r.description: Percorso ciclopedonale che attraversa in lunghezza l’Alta Valsesia, con passaggio nei siti artistici e culturali più rilevanti del territorio.

r.name: A45 - Pieve Vergonte - bivio B97 Alpe Pian Lago
r.description: Percorso impegnativo in ambiente selvaggio a tratti esposto conduce prima ad Alpe Colla e successivamente attraverso traverso agli alpeggi di Ghiaccetto , la Crosa da qui su flebile traccia a tratti esposta si raggiunge il bivio con percorso B97.

r.name: A47 - Fomarco - Pizzo Camino
r.description: A long and strenuous route with challenging sections, especially from Alpe il Ghiaccio onward. But the spectacular views you can enjoy during the climb and from the summit are worth the effort.

r.name: B23 - Ceppo Morelli - Passo del Tignaga
B25 - Ceppo Morelli - Passo del Laghetto
Z17 - Campello Monti - Cima di Capezzone
A41 - Rumianca - Alpe Pian Lago bivio B97
Z99 - Campello Monti - Colle dell'Usciolo
r.description: Climb to Colle dell'Usciolo following the route of the Grande Traversata delle Alpi and the Sentiero Italia. The trail is well marked and easy to follow, but the final section is extremely steep and less well marked.

r.name: Z17a Alpe Capezzone - Bocchetta di Campello

r.description: A connecting route to the Genoni Trail and the Miniera Pass. It's worth starting from Macugnaga, crossing the Bottiggia Pass, sleeping at the Massero Refuge and then returning via the Miniera Pass to Macugnaga.

r.name: 117 - Parte verso Carcoforo del Sentiero Genoni
GTA: Alpe del Lago - Campello Monti
GTA: Molini di Calasca - Alpe del Lago
B20 - Vanzone - Bivio C21 presso Pizzo San Martino
B20b - Alpe Asinello - Bivio B24
r.description: The path leads to the beautiful area of the Laghetti di Prebianca and with a circular tour you can go down towards Borgone, Ceppo Morelli or Mondelli

r.name: B08 - Calasca Dentro - Passo di Salarioli - Croce del Cavallo - Alpi della Colma
B30 - Vaud - Mondelli
r.description: The route starts from the main road at the bus stop. The connection with the B00 route (Vaud bridge) is on the main road. In the section between Stabioli and Mondelli in many places there is always water dangerous in case of frost.

r.name: B33 - Parte verso Macugnaga del Sentiero Genoni
r.description: Route reserved for expert hikers with often uneven and disused tracks. Final section with small climbing sections made easier by the presence of well-maintained safety ropes.

r.name: Z14b - Alpe Fornale sopra - Piana di Via
Z15a - Alpe del Vecchio - Passo del Crac
Z00b - Piana di Forno - Campello Monti
B97 - Ca Pioda - Colle dell'Usciolo
r.description: A long and tiring route with very steep sections, some ups and downs significantly increasing the elevation gain. The presence of two well-maintained bivouacs makes the journey easier.

r.name: B14 - San Carlo - Miniera dei Cani
r.description: Challenging route at times exposed as an alternative to the B16 to be avoided in case of ice or rain

r.name: B19b - Soi di dentro - Alpe Ielbi
B00e - Bivio B00 - Madonna della Neve
B12 - Madonna del Sassello - Alpe Vallar
B10 - Barzone di Calasca - Passo del Mottone
B15c - Bocchetto - Alpe Pie di Baranca
r.description: Steep path that leads to Drocaccia where there is a bivouac and from here following a path halfway up the hill you reach Piè di Baranca

r.name: B22 - Canfinello - Alpe Loccia
r.description: Very popular path up to Alpe Col, even in winter, little used at Alpe Loccia where it is invaded by ferns
